process.discoveryMethod: Whole-book OCR/TXT type-line scan, plus section discovery across Jedi pp137-139, Republic pp162-170, Confederacy pp197-203 and Kashyyyk pp219-221. Focus on separately headed complete vehicle statblocks rather than mentions, options or droid NPCs.
process.sourceVerification: Source SHA256 independently matched uploaded scanned PDF to repository historical Clone Wars ledger. Rendered printed vehicle-statblock pages and examined page layouts and printed headings, including p138, p163-170, p198-203, p219-220.
process.pdfPhysicalPageMethod: New claims verified with printed page +1 physical PDF page; inherited ship page/scan corrections preserved, especially inverted pp209/210.
process.exhaustivenessLimit: Text discovery can miss OCR-invisible material; rendered candidate pages verified, but not a claim of visual line-by-line inspection of all 225 physical PDF pages.

sourceIdentityPolicies.subject: Sheathipede-class Shuttle / Punworcca 116-class Sloop
sourceIdentityPolicies.policy: Preserve Phase1 identities and recorded printed-page swap; primary PDF pages around 209-210 scanned out of printed order. Do not blanket-recompute original physical page assignment from printed-page-plus-one.

sourceIdentityPolicies.subject: SPHA variants
sourceIdentityPolicies.policy: One published vehicle statblock with alternative SPHA-T, -I, -V, -C and -M primary armaments. Count once; represent variant configurations in Phase 2 without inventing five additional published identities.

sourceIdentityPolicies.subject: Grievous's Wheel Bike
sourceIdentityPolicies.policy: Independent named modified vehicle statblock on p203. Count separately from baseline Tsmeu-6 vehicle despite shared chassis.

sourceIdentityPolicies.subject: Manta Droid Subfighter
sourceIdentityPolicies.policy: Printed as 'Huge water vehicle (speeder)'; do not infer spaceflight from 'subfighter' name.

sourceIdentityPolicies.subject: Oevvaor Jet Catamaran
sourceIdentityPolicies.policy: Printed as 'Gargantuan vehicle (speeder)' and described for over-water use; preserve printed type and tag water primary.

sourceIdentityPolicies.subject: Droid entries
sourceIdentityPolicies.policy: Do not include large droids with NPC/droid statblocks unless the printed block explicitly defines a vehicle. Examples excluded: Ultra Droideka and Octuptarra Combat Tri-Droid.

sourceIdentityPolicies.subject: DC0052 airspeeder
sourceIdentityPolicies.policy: Stand-alone Jedi vehicle on p138 amid Jedi starship profiles; included despite being outside major military-vehicle chapters.

sourceIdentityPolicies.subject: AT-TE and BARC
sourceIdentityPolicies.policy: Printed type line and separate statblock for each on p165; do not conflate adjacent entries.
